 In 2021, Marvel Studios took a bold step by kicking off its Phase 4 slate with WandaVision on Disney+, making it the MCU's first post-Infinity Saga release. Elizabeth Olsen and Paul Bettany led the way as Wanda Maximoff and Vision, going through a sitcom-inspired adventure as Wanda created a magical hex in Westview, New Jersey, and built a family with her powers. The show became a massive hit and continued into two sequels in later years.

 The second sequel series, VisionQuest , is now approaching the end of its run on Disney+ behind Bettany's return as the titular Vision . This show brings Vision back alongside some of the MCU's most notable AI programs, including James Spader in his return as Ultron, as White Vision tries to piece together his identity after the Hex-created Vision implanted his memories into the new body. Now, as VisionQuest approaches the end of its run, Marvel adds another exciting release tied to the Disney+ series.
 Marvel Studios officially announced the release of the VisionQuest Official Podcast , which will begin airing on Disney+, YouTube, and other podcast-hosting platforms at 6 p.m. ET on Nov. 10, 2026. This will debut concurrently with the VisionQuest season finale on Disney+. The podcast will be hosted by The Basement Yard 's Frank Alvarez and Ms. Marvel star Iman Vellani, who previously co-hosted the Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday podcast .

 Alvarez and Vellani will dive deep into the VisionQuest story on this podcast, joined by a quartet of big names from the show. This will include Bettany and Spader, along with Tommy Maximoff star Ruaridh Mollica and showrunner Terry Matalas. Dropping online at the same time as the VisionQuest season finale, viewers will have the opportunity to see how the story comes to an end before enjoying an in-depth discussion about what happened from the professionals who made it happen.
 For now, the major question is exactly how this story will end, particularly given that it concludes the trilogy that began with WandaVision and Agatha All Along (2024) . The show finally answered the mystery of the client that has persisted throughout the season, and Vision continues working towards rediscovering his true identity after his experience with Wanda in the Hex.

 From here, Marvel's TV slate will slow down, as the only currently confirmed live-action Disney+ releases moving forward are Daredevil: Born Again Season 3 in Mar. 2027 and Zodiac in 2028. It is also unknown if or when Bettany will return as Vision, as is the case with Elizabeth Olsen's Wanda Maximoff, Ruaridh Mollica's Tommy Maximoff, and Joe Locke's Billy Maximoff.
